enemy_1018_aoemag.description: An elite Caster, capable of dealing AoE Ranged Arts damage. Attacks will deal damage to units adjacent to the primary target.
enemy_1018_aoemag.lore: One of Reunion's elite Casters. They use complex Area-of-Effect Arts, making them more potent than normal Casters. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Deals area damage to Operators on the four cardinal tiles next to the primary target.

enemy_1018_aoemag_2.description: A dangerous elite caster that attacks using AoE Ranged Arts. Attacks will deal damage to units adjacent to the primary target.
enemy_1018_aoemag_2.lore: One of Reunion's elite Casters, more dangerous than a normal Caster Leader. They use complex Area-of-Effect Arts, making them more potent than normal Casters. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Deals area damage to Operators on the four cardinal tiles next to the primary target.

enemy_1006_shield.description: A Reunion melee soldier that has very high defense and is difficult to take down.
enemy_1006_shield.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

enemy_1006_shield_2.description: A more dangerous version of the Heavy Defender that has very high defense and is difficult to take down.
enemy_1006_shield_2.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Heavy Defender. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

enemy_1006_shield_3.description: A heavily-armored elite soldier, more dangerous than a Heavy Defender Leader, that has very high defense and is difficult to take down.
enemy_1006_shield_3.lore: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a Heavy Defender Leader. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they usually appear alongside a large number of troops and are extremely hard to defeat. Proceed with caution.

enemy_1010_demon.description: A mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES.
enemy_1010_demon.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

enemy_1010_demon_2.description: A more dangerous mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES.
enemy_1010_demon_2.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Swordsman. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

enemy_1012_dcross.description: A mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES and uses ranged attacks.
enemy_1012_dcross.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

enemy_1012_dcross_2.description: A more dangerous mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES and uses ranged attacks.
enemy_1012_dcross_2.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Sniper. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

enemy_1022_dmage.description: A mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES and uses ranged Arts attacks. They are known to use Arts Chains to disable Operators.
enemy_1022_dmage.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

enemy_1022_dmage_2.description: A mercenary from Sarkaz who boasts fairly high ATK and RES and uses ranged Arts attacks. They are known to use Arts Chains to disable Operators.
enemy_1022_dmage_2.lore: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Caster. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

enemy_1025_reveng.description: A soldier that has a stronger will to fight when low on HP.
enemy_1025_reveng.lore: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

enemy_1025_reveng_2.description: A soldier that has a stronger will to fight when low on HP.
enemy_1025_reveng_2.lore: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods, more dangerous than a normal Avenger. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

enemy_1033_handax.description: An enemy of unknown identity who wears logging equipment and attacks with lumbering tools.
enemy_1033_handax.lore: An enemy of unknown identity who wears logging equipment and attacks with lumbering tools. Because of their attire, weapon, and machine-like behavior, they are often called 'Log Splitters.'

enemy_1033_handax_2.description: An enemy of unknown identity who wears logging equipment and attacks with lumbering tools. More dangerous than normal Loggers.
enemy_1033_handax_2.lore: An enemy of unknown identity who wears logging equipment and attacks with lumbering tools. They dye their clothes red to make it easier to identify them, but are also harder to deal with. Their nickname is a bit more human-sounding than 'Log Splitter,' but humans are more terrifying than any machine.

enemy_1034_laxe.description: An enemy of unknown identity who attacks using a massive blunt object. They possess relatively high defense.
enemy_1034_laxe.lore: An enemy of unknown identity who wears white industrial overalls and attacks with a massive blunt object. Their appearances and combat style readily reminds people of those serial killers from movies, hence their nickname - Butcher.

enemy_1034_laxe_2.description: An enemy of unknown identity who attacks using a massive blunt object. This variant is even more dangerous than a normal Butcher, and has relatively high defense.
enemy_1034_laxe_2.lore: An enemy of unknown identity who wears white industrial overalls and attacks with a massive blunt object. Their hoods have been dyed red to symbolize greater strength and power compared to the rest of their ranks. It is only fitting that their nickname also reflects this.

enemy_1035_haxe.description: An enemy of unknown identity who attacks using a massive blunt object. They possess high defense.
enemy_1035_haxe.lore: An enemy of unknown identity. Equipped with a complex array of armor, a gas mask, and tanks of unidentifiable substances, they attack using giant blunt instruments. Due to their logic-defying equipment, they are simply called 'Armed Militants.' Though their movement is slow, even a single swing of their weapon is sure to inflict massive damage. Proceed with caution.

enemy_1035_haxe_2.description: An enemy of unknown identity who attacks using a massive blunt object. This variant is even more dangerous than normal Armed Militants, and also has high defense.
enemy_1035_haxe_2.lore: An enemy of unknown identity. Equipped with a complex array of armor, a gas mask, and tanks of unidentifiable substances, they attack using giant blunt instruments. Based on their equipment, they are even more dangerous than a normal Armed Militant. Though their movement is slow, even a single swing of their weapon is sure to inflict massive damage. Proceed with caution.

enemy_1036_amraoe.description: An elite Reunion caster who attacks using ranged AoE Arts. Their shields provide them with higher physical defense.
enemy_1036_amraoe.lore: One of Reunion's elite Casters. They use complex Area-of-Effect Arts, making them more potent than normal Casters. They also seem to have fortified their defenses with Arts. and must be handled with caution. Due to their special state, they may be more vulnerable to Arts damage.

abilities.text: Deals area damage to Operators on the four cardinal tiles next to the primary target.

enemy_1040_bombd.description: [Aerial Unit] Each of them carries an explosive that can be fired at nearby Operators to cause AOE physical damage.
enemy_1040_bombd.lore: An unmanned enemy drone that flies slowly. They carry an explosive warhead that is launched when approaching nearby Operators, inflicting physical damage in an area. Their design seems to have been inspired by a fantasy creature. Though they cannot attack anymore after launching the warhead, their movement speed increases afterwards due to the loss of weight.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE physical damage
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after launching warhead

enemy_1040_bombd_2.description: [Aerial Unit] Each of them carries a large explosive that can be fired at nearby Operators to cause AOE physical damage.
enemy_1040_bombd_2.lore: An unmanned enemy drone that flies slowly. They carry a large explosive warhead that is launched when approaching nearby Operators, inflicting physical damage in an area. Their design seems to have been inspired by a fantasy creature. Though they cannot attack anymore after launching the warhead, their movement speed increases afterwards due to the loss of weight.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE physical damage
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after launching warhead

enemy_1042_frostd.description: [Aerial Unit] A flying unit with high DEF that can significantly reduce the attack speed of nearby Operators.
enemy_1042_frostd.lore: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

enemy_1045_hammer.description: An elite Reunion soldier clad in a heavy blast suit, capable of stunning Operators after a few attacks.
enemy_1045_hammer.lore: One of Reunion's senior elites, clad in a heavy blast suit. Each swing from their weapon is slow but packs tremendous destructive power. Operators will be stunned after taking several attacks.Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

enemy_1045_hammer_2.description: A more dangerous Defense Crusher, capable of stunning Operators after a few attacks.
enemy_1045_hammer_2.lore: One of Reunion's senior elites, clad in a heavy blast suit and more dangerous than a normal Defense Crusher. Each swing from their weapon is slow but packs tremendous destructive power. Operators will be stunned after taking several attacks. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

enemy_1048_hirman.description: These melee soldiers inflict heavy damage with their tactical axes. The armor they wear provides them with bonus RES when blocked.
enemy_1048_hirman.lore: A melee soldier. They use standard-issue tactical axes to inflict heavy damage to their targets. When they are blocked by allied Operators, their armor provides improved Arts resistance.

abilities.text: Gains increased RES when blocked

enemy_1048_hirman_2.description: A terrifying, more dangerous variant of the Rockbreaker. The armor they wear provides them with greater bonus RES when blocked.
enemy_1048_hirman_2.lore: A melee soldier. They are more dangerous than normal Rockbreakers, They use standard-issue tactical axes to inflict heavy damage to their targets. Proceed with caution.

abilities.text: Gains greatly increased RES when blocked

enemy_1049_eagent.description: Their attacks reduce Operators' ability to block other enemies, making it easier for enemies to get through.
enemy_1049_eagent.lore: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

enemy_1049_eagent_2.description: A more dangerous Agent with stronger combat abilities. Their attacks reduce Operators' ability to block other enemies, making it easier for enemies to get through.
enemy_1049_eagent_2.lore: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are stronger than normal Agents. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

enemy_1054_norshd.description: A heavily-clad melee combatant. They possess extremely high defense, so proceed with caution.
enemy_1054_norshd.lore: A melee soldier. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, these experienced soldiers are skilled at dealing with a wide variety of physical attacks. They are hard to take down and must be dealt with carefully.

enemy_1054_norshd_2.description: Compared to the Heavy Defender Type-N, they have extremely high defense and are even harder to defeat. Please proceed with caution.
enemy_1054_norshd_2.lore: A melee soldier. They are more dangerous than normal Heavy Defenders. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, these experienced soldiers are skilled at dealing with a wide variety of physical attacks. They are hard to take down and must be dealt with carefully.

enemy_1058_traink.description: Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.
enemy_1058_traink.lore: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

enemy_1058_traink_2.description: Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.
enemy_1058_traink_2.lore: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all. Compared to a normal Bully, they boast greater attack power and armor.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

enemy_1059_buster.description: They will prioritize attacking facilities first and can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.
enemy_1059_buster.lore: Special long-range combatants. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

enemy_1059_buster_2.description: They will prioritize attacking facilities first and can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.
enemy_1059_buster_2.lore: Special long-range combatants, with greater combat capabilities than normal Fanatics. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

enemy_1060_emouse.description: Can deploy a shield that grants a large amount of DEF; the shield can be destroyed with Arts damage and upon being destroyed, this unit will gain a large amount of movement speed.
enemy_1060_emouse.lore: The Rat King's elite guard, granted special Originium Arts by the Rat King, allowing him to create a Barrier to protect himself. Movement speed is increased when the Barrier is broken.

abilities.text: DEF significantly increases when the Barrier is present.
Movement Speed significantly increases when the Barrier is destroyed.

enemy_1060_emouse_2.description: Can deploy a shield that grants a large amount of DEF; the shield can be destroyed with Arts damage and upon being destroyed, this unit will gain a large amount of movement speed.
enemy_1060_emouse_2.lore: The Rat King's elite guard, granted special Originium Arts by the Rat King, allowing him to create a Barrier to protect himself. Movement speed is increased when the Barrier is broken. Stronger in combat than a Greytail.

abilities.text: DEF significantly increases when the Barrier is present.
Movement Speed significantly increases when the Barrier is destroyed.

enemy_1061_zomshd.description: A heavy defender that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1061_zomshd.lore: A heavy defender that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. Well-protected by elite tactical gear, the appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1061_zomshd_2.description: A heavy defender leader that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly.
enemy_1061_zomshd_2.lore: A heavy defender leader that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. Well-protected by elite tactical gear, the appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Regenerates HP over time.

enemy_1062_rager.description: A possessed enemy combatant that has descended into madness, having extremely high ATK. Loses HP over time.
enemy_1062_rager.lore: An enemy combatant who has slowly descended into primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and they are unusually aggressive as a result. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time

enemy_1062_rager_2.description: A possessed enemy combatant that has completely given in to madness, having extremely high ATK. Loses HP over time.
enemy_1062_rager_2.lore: An enemy combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and their death-defying aggression breaks the bounds of reason. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time

enemy_1063_rageth.description: A possessed enemy ranged combatant that has descended into madness, having extremely high ATK. Loses HP over time.
enemy_1063_rageth.lore: An enemy ranged combatant who has slowly descended into primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and they will hurl whatever they can get their hands on at their targets. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time

enemy_1063_rageth_2.description: A possessed enemy ranged combatant that has completely given in to madness, having extremely high ATK. Loses HP over time.
enemy_1063_rageth_2.lore: An enemy ranged combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, they will even rip out the Originium lodged inside their bodies to throw because of their deadened sense of pain. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time

enemy_1069_icebrk.description: A special Yeti Squadron melee combatant, capable of inflicting massive damage to Frozen units
enemy_1069_icebrk.lore: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Grim reapers on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, hence the nickname they've been given, 'Ice Cleaver.'

abilities.text: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1069_icebrk_2.description: A special Yeti Squadron elite melee combatant, capable of inflicting catastrophic damage to Frozen units
enemy_1069_icebrk_2.lore: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.

abilities.text: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

enemy_1070_iced.description: [Aerial Unit]Carries a special warhead capable of dealing Arts damage in an area and inflicting Cold on affected Operators.
enemy_1070_iced.lore: An unmanned, slow-flying enemy drone equipped with a special warhead released upon approaching Operators that inflicts Arts damage and a freezing effect in an area. Modified from the Bombtail, they lost their ability to accelerate after delivering the payload in order to accomodate a special warhead.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE Arts damage and apply the Cold effect to targets

enemy_1072_dlancer.description: Gradually accelerates when moving, dealing bonus damage on the first hit after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.
enemy_1072_dlancer.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.

abilities.text: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

enemy_1072_dlancer_2.description: More threatening than normal Sarkaz Lancers. Gradually accelerates when moving, dealing bonus damage on the first hit after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.
enemy_1072_dlancer_2.lore: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.

abilities.text: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

enemy_1074_dbskar.description: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts.
enemy_1074_dbskar.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, allowing them to unleash Arts without relying on a staff. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

enemy_1074_dbskar_2.description: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts.
enemy_1074_dbskar_2.lore: An elite Sarkaz caster mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, and their accumulated resentment has crystallized into raw power. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

enemy_1075_dmgswd.description: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.
enemy_1075_dmgswd.lore: A Sarkaz mercenary. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

enemy_1075_dmgswd_2.description: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.
enemy_1075_dmgswd_2.lore: An elite Sarkaz mercenary who has mastered the combination of swordsmanship and Arts. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.

abilities.text: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

enemy_1076_bsthmr.description: Elite Reunion troops whose attacks cause explosions, dealing Splash damage to units in the four tiles surrounding the primary target.
enemy_1076_bsthmr.lore: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.

abilities.text: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

enemy_1076_bsthmr_2.description: Elite Reunion troops whose attacks cause explosions, dealing Splash damage to units in the four tiles surrounding the primary target.
enemy_1076_bsthmr_2.lore: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear, more aggressive than normal Demolitionists. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.

abilities.text: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

enemy_1081_sotisd.description: Covers the advance of enemy troops by making themselves more likely to be attacked.
enemy_1081_sotisd.lore: One of Patriot's elite defenders. Carrying out Patriot's will, these shieldguards form the solid foundation of the 'Aegis of the Infected.' Equipped with high-performance protective armor, they cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.

abilities.text: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

enemy_1081_sotisd_2.description: Covers the advance of enemy troops by making themselves more likely to be attacked.
enemy_1081_sotisd_2.lore: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite defenders. After extensive training, the Shieldguard Leaders don heavier protective armor and cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.

abilities.text: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

enemy_1082_soticn.description: Gains significantly increased ASPD when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1082_soticn.lore: One of Patriot's elite suppression troops. Adept at long-ranged shelling, these fighters move more slowly because of their medium armor but also enjoy increased protection. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have significantly increased attack speed.

abilities.text: When Inspired, gains greatly increased ASPD.

enemy_1082_soticn_2.description: Gains significantly increased ASPD when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1082_soticn_2.lore: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite suppression troops. Compared to ordinary mortars, these troops equip more dangerous and destructive shells. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have significantly increased attack speed.

abilities.text: When Inspired, gains greatly increased ASPD.

enemy_1083_sotiab.description: Gains significantly increased ATK when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1083_sotiab.lore: One of Patriot's elite assault fighters. These troops specialize in assaults and airborne operations into enemy backlines. They wear medium armor and boast very strong individual combat capabilities. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have greatly increased attack power.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
When Inspired, gains greatly increased ATK.

enemy_1083_sotiab_2.description: Gains massively increased ATK when Inspired by a Herald or by Patriot.
enemy_1083_sotiab_2.lore: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite assault fighters. Though boasting greater individual combat capabilities than normal Siegebreakers, they often end up behind bars. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have greatly increased attack power.

abilities.text: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
When Inspired, gains massively increased ATK.

enemy_1084_sotidm.description: Does not take damage when coming in contact with a Pulse Wave, and attacks instead deal Arts damage.

The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.

abilities.text: When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and will deal Arts damage with normal attacks.

enemy_9003_askate.lore: A Lateran pushing around boxes of ammunition. Apparently, whenever his comrades need bullets, he will drop from the sky to deliver what they need. A true 'angel'.

enemy_9004_anlock.lore: A convict in charge of prison maintenance, for everything from the building itself to the imprisonment devices. When the jailers aren't looking, they will spontaneously start prison riots.

enemy_9005_aicemn.lore: A ruthless archer of the icefields. Cold as glaciers, her arrows induce hypothermia, as if dragging victims into the depths of a frigid abyss.

enemy_5501_arcbank.lore: Easter egg present in many games. He seems to think of gaming as an industry that belongs to him, and tries to exact a toll from every player it encounters.

enemy_5502_arcthf.lore: Classic easter egg present in many games. He encountered your game as he was fleeing pursuit. Defeat him to earn a great windfall.

enemy_18004_lhbmom.description: Gives nearby enemies Inspiration equal to 100% of own DEF, and periodically summons two Pincerbugs
enemy_18004_lhbmom.lore: The strongest pincerbugs become the pride of their colony. The others bring food to them, while they focus on protecting the colony and producing offspring. Their tough, shield-like elytra have earned them the moniker 'shield-bug'.

enemy_9006_actoxi.description: When defeated, fires a poison cloud at the damage source, dealing Arts damage over time.
enemy_9006_actoxi.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate the corrosive nature of Originium. Originium in nature corrodes other substances, just as it eats away at biological tissue in Oripathy patients. Is coexistence with Originium possible? That is what we want to find out in these simulations.

abilities.text: When defeated, fires a poison cloud at the target that defeated it, continuously dealing Arts damage to the surroundings

enemy_9007_acelem.description: When blocked, plants itself on the blocker, dealing Arts damage over time, and causing the target to take more Elemental Injury; spreads to the 4 adjacent tiles when Elemental Burst occurs.
enemy_9007_acelem.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate the liquid form of Originium. No one knows why it began to take such form, but it may be the precursor to another Originium disaster. Through simulation, we will find a way to destroy it, control it, or utilize it.

abilities.text: Less likely to be attacked

enemy_9008_acbunn.description: Invisible; attacks 3 targets simultaneously when Invisible.
enemy_9008_acbunn.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate the structure of Originium formations. Flaws and inaccuracies are inevitable in metallic construction, but the dangerous sharpness of crystal formations has been faithfully recreated. Overcome your primal fears through simulation.

enemy_9009_acfort.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate Catastrophe clouds. Catastrophes have been the enemy of civilization since the beginning of time, and the Originium clusters forming beneath them are the symbol of death. Find ways to fight Catastrophes through simulation.

enemy_9010_acpupp.description: When defeated, becomes a puppet and gives nearby other enemies 5 Shield; puppet must be damaged 30 times to be defeated and cannot be blocked, reviving after some time.
enemy_9010_acpupp.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate monsters born from Originium. We have fought such foes on the Rhodes Island landship, adversaries that regenerate, rise again, and kill wearing the form of the fallen. Study ways to counter them through simulation.

enemy_9011_acrefr.lore: OpFor unit designed to emulate machines hijacked by Originium. We have fought such foes on the Rhodes Island landship, as Originium took our machines and gave them dangerous new abilities. Discover solutions through simulation.

enemy_9012_acloon.description: A device that focuses the strength of Yan natives; periodically shoots fire at enemies.

Originium retrieves a shadow from the boundless ocean, giving it a new body and voice. The silent sea encompasses all, except for that future the shadow caught a glimpse of in the Pavillon.
